writeup: Woot has a new Cisco Meraki MA-ANT-20 dual-band omni antenna set for $36.39. NetworkTigers lists the matching new two-antenna set (UPC 810979012115, 4.7 dBi N-type) in stock for $167.99, with five available. That is about 78 percent below NetworkTigers and saves roughly $132. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
